Privacy

What your friends and other players see of you.

My statusAppear offline: your friends see you offline. You still count in the number of players online, without your name.
Show friends what I playThe game you are in, its map, your role and since when. Off: your friends see "Playing Propnight" and cannot join you from their list.
Who can see my profileStats and most played characters. Your name, rank, avatar, banner and flag stay visible.
Who can see my recent matchesThe last matches on your profile.
Show me in the leaderboard by nameOff: you appear as "Hidden player", with your numbers.
Public profile pageA page on the site (propnightrevival.online/u/your name) that anyone with the link can open, with a preview in Discord. It shows what strangers see of your profile.

Discord

Your Discord profile and our community server.

Discord activityShows on your Discord profile what you do: in the launcher, your group, the lobby or the match.
Show my level and rankYour avatar, level and rank on your Discord profile. A View profile button shows when your public profile page is on (Privacy).
Our Discord serverNews, help from the team, players to play with.
Cast HUD when spectatingOnce you are out of a match (dead or escaped): the survivors, the generators and the killer's abilities over the game.
Cast HUD for OBSFor streams and tournaments: in OBS, add a Browser source with this address (1920 x 1080) over your game capture. It shows while you spectate a match.

    Propnight is still running

    Closing the launcher does not close the game, you can keep playing. But until you open the launcher again:

    • your progress (coins, skins, rank) is not saved online: it is uploaded the next time you open the launcher,
    • your friends see you offline and their invites will not reach you in the game,
    • your match results and player reports wait on your PC and are sent later.
